title: Closed category list for reason labels (evaluator-only)
description: The closed list of invariant-or-mechanism categories that `category` in a reason label (schemas/reason-label.schema.json) must be drawn from. Per docs/h1-pre-registration.md the list is built while labelling the first ten cases, not designed up front, so this document starts empty and grows only by appending: an entry records which case forced it. Once labelling passes the first ten cases the list is frozen; adding a category after that is a dated decision, and relabelling under the new list produces a new list version. Evaluator-only, same access rule as the labels it governs.

cohort_records_sha256.description: records_sha256 of the cohort manifest the list was built against.

frozen.description: False while the first ten cases are being labelled; true afterwards. Labels adjudicated against an unfrozen list must be re-checked once it freezes.

categories.description: Append-only; order is the order categories were needed. `id` values are unique.

id.description: Stable identifier used by reason labels, e.g. init-order, error-path, config-interaction.

definition.description: What a case must exhibit to be filed here, written so a second adjudicator would file the same case the same way.

introduced_by_pr.description: The case whose labelling required this category.

diff_predictable.description: The pre-registration's prior for this class: whether a review-time reader is expected to be able to see it in the diff. Recorded so recall can be reported by failure class against the stated expectation.
